main_scope: ordinary Manual, qualified frozen geometries; no target-building answers in learned labels
outer_split: leave one building out; full fit is descriptive only
inner_split: three deterministic groups of training buildings; same assignment shared by all candidates in a fold

pair_support.unsupported: retain counts and unknown; shrink to training building-weighted prior for clustering only

global_relationships: same-image same-condition same-reference relations, first averaged within image then building; geometrical probability and observed swap risk kept separately
partial_pooling: pair posterior with equivalent two-building training-global prior; sensitivity/no-prior relation columns retained
conditional_variant: For each frozen base class and observed difficulty, two-way refinement is attempted only when at least four members meet difficulty support; a split is retained only if both children have at least two members. Ineligible members are unknown for the conditional variant. A retained group is not selected using test-image data.
selection_objective: inner heldout-building mean Brier for joint_main stability, calibrated using within/between category and k/difficulty train events; unknown class receives train baseline
selection_rule: one-standard-error preference for smaller effective class count; deterministic ties global before conditional, geometry9 before geometry12 before geometry9_swap_equal before swap_joint, average before complete
class_id_arbitrariness: canonical displayed ID sorted by smallest worker ID; compare across folds by pair co-assignment, not numeric ID
required_diagnostics: all class-internal supported pairs, bad tails and unknown coverage
same-class pair coassignment stability across outer folds
joint stability and component/signed differences separately
raw and Q-near matched comparisons on identical events
training relation and target actual cluster information stages separated
forbidden: validation outcome-driven class count or threshold tuning
class labels as formal worker tier

nontransitivity_diagnostic.definition: supported historical geometry pair probabilities; count wedges A~B,B~C but A far C. Diagnostic only, not graph connected components.

shared_selection_code: reverse/selection_common.py; independently reviewed by forward route before outcome access
event_panel_freeze_reason: Root common design: inner selection and historical swap relationship use archived fixed-background events only. New nested backgrounds are evaluation-only; no candidate result had been inspected.
